targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(aqara|soil).*Temperature$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "Indoor Avg")
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "avg Temperature"})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "avg Temperature", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supplyAirTemperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "Supply Air")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(soil1|soil2|soil3|aqara1|aqara2|aqara3)Humidity$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement:
      if r._measurement == "soil1Humidity" then "Obývák (květináč)"
      else if r._measurement == "soil2Humidity" then "Ložnice (květináč)"
      else if r._measurement == "soil3Humidity" then "Zádveří (květináč)"
      else if r._measurement == "aqara1Humidity" then "Koupelna sprcha"
      else if r._measurement == "aqara2Humidity" then "Prádelna"
      else if r._measurement == "aqara3Humidity" then "Koupelna vana"
      else r._measurement
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "co2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(aqara1|aqara2|aqara3)Pressure$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "Atmosférický tlak")
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Atmospheric Pressure"})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "Atmospheric Pressure", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(outdoorAirTemperature|supplyAirTemperature|extractAirTemperature|exhaustAirTemperature)$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement:
      if r._measurement == "outdoorAirTemperature" then "Intake"
      else if r._measurement == "supplyAirTemperature" then "Supply"
      else if r._measurement == "extractAirTemperature" then "Extract"
      else if r._measurement == "exhaustAirTemperature" then "Exhaust"
      else r._measurement
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement:
      if r._measurement == "hrvOutputPower" then "Base Power"
      else if r._measurement == "hrvOutputIntake" then "Intake Power"
      else if r._measurement == "hrvOutputExhaust" then "Exhaust Power"
      else r._measurement
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

      else if r._measurement == "aqara3Temperature" then "Koupelna vana"
      else r._measurement
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])
